info.name: Mini ERP API
info.description:
Run the folders in order (Collection Runner) or one request at a time.

1. Start the backend (npm start in backend/) and set the baseUrl variable if it is not http://localhost:4000/api.
2. Run "Login as SALES" first; the JWT is stored in {{token}} and sent as a Bearer token by every other request.
3. Requests named "(expect 4xx)" show a business rule refusing a request; their tests assert that status.

Test users: admin@erp.com / Admin@123 (ADMIN), sales@erp.com / Sales@123 (SALES).
